name: icebreaker-bingo
description: Etkinlikler icin Firebase tabanli, Google girisli tanisma bingosu
author: Hüseyin Eren Çeykel

scripts.deploy: node scripts/build-rules.mjs && vite build && firebase deploy
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-bingo-sec "node test/security.mjs" && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-bingo "node test/rules.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.emulators: ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com node scripts/build-rules.mjs && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore --project demo-bingo-e2e
